newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: ING Barings upgrades Argentine growth to 6.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: ING Barings upgrades Argentine growth to 6.6 pct.

text.p: Dutch bank ING Barings said Tuesday it had upgraded Argentina's gross domestic product growth forecast for 1997 to 6.6 percent from 5.2 percent.
"We are revising our real GDP growth forecast for 1997 to 6.6 percent from 5.2 percent, based primarily on the performance of the economy so far this year," ING Barings said in a statement.
"The economy appears to be surging ahead, faster than we and most forecasters had anticipated," it added.
ING Barings forecast that consumption would rise 5.2 percent, and investment would increase 17.8 percent this year. Exports were seen advancing 12.5 percent while imports were seen up 18.6 percent.
"We expect 1997 growth to be propelled mostly by investment and exports, with consumption growing at a more moderate pace," the bank added.
ING Barings said it not expect October's legislative elections to affect economic performance.
